title: Absolute CoAP cache deadlines
description: CoAP proxy caches convert relative Max-Age to absolute deadline: cache_deadline = received_at + max_age_seconds. Eliminates clock-drift accumulation on multi-hop cache chains. All proxies agree on the exact expiry instant. Reject cached responses when now() > cache_deadline. Spec: 07-transport-app.md §10.3. All three impls (wherever CoAP proxy/caching is implemented).
